Fade out running

■Direction
Prioritizing literal count of laughter syllables ("ha")

■Direction
Age: around 5 years old
Personality: energetic

■Direction
Walks in
---
★Request
Fade in walking: Hishi Akebono

■Direction
Age: 30s
Personality: hearty

★Request
Costume: Casual
...If we do that, will I understand?
Yeah, of course!
Hishi Akebono called out to them cheerfully.
Whoa, that's not all!

Haha, you got that right!
You can't build this kind of body without chanko!

All righty☆ Let's go buy some ingredients!
The shopping district's probably better for groceries, right?

Yup, that's right! My dad is an Italian chef,
and my mom is a pastry chef~.

Whenever I find something new,
I always send it to the two of them~.

Whenever you smile while eating the food I made, Trainer,
it makes me super happy.

Hishi Akebono asked all sorts of questions with keen interest,
and the sumo wrestlers happily answered every one.

It makes my chest feel all warm and fuzzy...
It's kind of hard to put into words, though~.

Could I treat Hishi Akebono to something
as a thank-you for always cooking for me?

I was checking out side dishes and sweets~.
Thought I'd buy whatever new items they had!

Besides, chanko is a dish packed full of heart.
There's no way you won't get strong on it!

Both my dad and mom are culinary pros,
so they get super excited about it.

Hmm... In that case, I'll make tonight's dinner,
so I hope you'll enjoy eating it again!
I mean, by the time you're eating it, the food's already finished, right?

It was truly buono, so I sent photos
and my thoughts to my mom and dad right away~.
Huh?! Where, where?!

Whoa, real ones...! 
Trainer, do you mind if I go talk to them?!

True chanko is packed with the heartfelt feelings
of both the maker and the eater! Hwahaha!
Huh? Try it out?
True chanko...? The feelings of the eater?

Hishi Akebono seemed to be having so much fun.
It would definitely be best to treat her to a home-cooked meal.
I have to put all my gratitude into making it—!
I'm gonna make a ton of food~!

True chanko...
Trainer, do you know what he meant?
Ehehe, so you don't need to thank me at all☆

Ah, Trainer!
What a coincidence~. Did you come here to shop?
Look! It's sumo wrestlers!

Yup, I went with macarons today!
Raspberry flavor, I just ate them at the rest area a minute ago☆

So while I love cooking, 
I also love finding yummy treats!

A meal is only complete when met with "itadakimasu"
and heartfelt gratitude.
The eater's feelings... what they feel, huh...

Mm-hmm. Nutritious chanko nabe really is
the secret to getting strong~.

You mean the feeling of wanting someone to enjoy it, right!
I always pour tons of love into my cooking too!
Huh? What's this all of a sudden?
Huh?

... Okay, got it!
Let's do it, Trainer!

Following the child's voice and gaze, I saw
a group of sumo wrestlers who looked fresh off practice.
With that in mind, I headed to the shopping mall, where—
What the wrestler meant was surely "mutual feelings of gratitude."
Excuuuse me! Hello!

Hishi Akebono had saved my life when we first met, and since then,
she had nourished both my body and soul with countless delicious meals.
I see, so the ingredients for chanko nabe are...!

Eeeh? You don't have to thank me!
Just seeing you satisfied makes me super happy, Trainer.

I'm thinking of making a chicken mizutaki tonight,
but there are other—

Hmm, I wonder what it means
to pour in the eater's feelings...
